200.description: Service is ready to receive traffic.

503.description: The service is draining, or Postgres or Kafka is not reachable, and must not receive new traffic.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Every error response in this service uses this shape with Content-Type application/problem+json.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve to a real page). Stable per distinct error category in this service.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced the error, omitted if there is no natural resource path.

schema.title: Problem
